mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia can lower seizure threshold and reduce lamotrigine efficacy, while lamotrigine may increase risk of adverse effects in electrolyte-depleted states.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly; maintain adequate potassium and sodium levels; consider potassium-sparing agent or adjust bumetanide dosing if hypokalemia develops during concurrent therapy.
